title: Chinese Academy of Social Science psychic abilities laboratory

tellings.quote: as soon as I showed up the first thing she did is she brought me to the laboratory showing me all these experiments they were doing with psychic abilities and they were exploring and trying to figure out what what all this was

plain: In 1990s Beijing, a laboratory at the Chinese Academy of Social Science was running experiments on psychic abilities, trying to work out what such powers were. That is the account of a lawyer named Dan Sheehan, who tells Michels he saw it himself: he says a woman he names as Jen Jo Jing took him there the moment he arrived and showed him "all these experiments they were doing with psychic abilities." If true, it would mean China was studying the paranormal seriously at the same time as the West, and Sheehan places the visit in a story that also involves Mikhail Gorbachev and James Baker.
